export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page for REXEL INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED (address: OFFICE NO. 101, SURVEY NO. 40, AMBEDKAR ROAD, SANGAMWADI) shows an outbound record: "2026-02-26 | REXEL INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED | AWM ELECTRICAL SUPPORT - CLEATS - PART Code.NH00003195638- | CHENNAI AIR CARGO ACC INMAA4, India | MELBOURNE, AUSTRALIA | 39209110 | 1026598" — i.e. India-origin, destination Australia, HS 39209110, B/L 1026598. Source counter: page header states "Total Shipments 5900 Records detected", "Trading Partners 68", "Ports 63"; rows actually visible in the free view: 5 shipment rows (dates 2026-02-27, 2026-02-26, 2026-02-25, 2026-02-24, 2026-02-19). Of those 5 visible rows, 4 are inbound (supplier abroad -> Rexel India, e.g. "2026-02-24 | DUTEIL ARNAUNE SAS | REXEL INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED | ... | PARIS CHARLES DE G, FRANCE | CHENNAI AIR CARGO ACC INMAA4, India | 84818090 | 7709607") and 1 is outbound. So the export side is confirmed by a single visible record, not by the 5,900 headline figure.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report India split could be retrieved: thecompanycheck.com and zaubacorp.com both returned HTTP 403 to this fetch, and web_search was unavailable (searx connection refused) for the whole session. Nothing on the ImportKey page speaks to domestic Indian supply. Field left as unknown rather than inferred from the company's size or from its parent group.
note: Rexel India Pvt Ltd is the Indian arm of the French Rexel electrical-distribution group; the customs address is in Pune (Sangamwadi), Maharashtra. IMPORTANT on the declared HS code: the batch declares 848180 (taps/valves), but the visible records are electrical/electronic and cable items — 85444999 (insulated cable, 2026-02-27), 39209110 (plastic cleats, 2026-02-26), 85369090 (connectors, 2026-02-25), 84818090 (2026-02-24, the only valve-class line, and it is an inbound French shipment of a "TRAVERSE/CROSSBAR"), 39169090 (silicone profile, 2026-02-19). Per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground: the company stays in the base and the code should be corrected to the actual traded profile (electrical distribution equipment, HS 8536/8544 family), verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Role: trader/distributor (manufacturer_trader at most) — the records show it buying from OMERIN, PEI-Genesis, Winchester Interconnect, AMCO, Duteil Arnaune and reselling, not producing. Caveat on the export finding: the single outbound row is a small air-cargo consignment of cleats to Melbourne, and the same page's "Buyers" block lists ALSTOM TRANSPORT AUSTRALIA PTY LTD with 2157 shipments against a mixed supplier list, which is an aggregated counterparty view and not proof of Rexel-specific export volume — I did not treat it as such. Export volume, FOB value and destination breakdown beyond this one record are behind a paywall and are recorded as null, not estimated. Domestic supply: no traces found in the sources reachable today, but this is a source-access failure (403s), not evidence of absence — hence unknown, not none_found.
